title: Common-render image-adjoint target-gradient diagnostic
question: Can direct propagation of the image-adjoint difference provide a numerically controlled comparison of photograph and field gradients, and what are those differences at the predeclared saved states?
hypothesis: The old identical-target parameter-gradient failure is consistent with numerical repeat variation; common-render image-adjoint differences pass the zero-effect controls while retaining the nonzero target-gradient difference on the same frozen development states.
claim_boundary: One previously exposed calibrated capture, cached downscale-eight training targets, three existing seeds and saved initial/final states. No optimization, optimizer-update replay, topology change, heldout evaluation, high-quality reconstruction, end-to-end field-only recovery, physical density, causal failure attribution or speed claim. Gradients use the stated reconstructed saved-state coordinates; exported opacity is not a preserved raw optimizer logit. This follow-up is designed after the failed numerical control in 20260909_field_target_gradient_stage_frame00008; its five partial states and failed sixth control were exposed. The old run remains failed and is not completed or retuned. Common-render derived field gradients use g_field = g_photo + J_transpose(h_field-h_photo); they are a first-order saved-state diagnostic, not a replay of independently accumulated historical GPU gradients.

stages.label: Numerical control
stages.purpose: On the predeclared failed state/view and photo target only, separate render, image-adjoint and parameter-VJP repeat variation and validate common-render zero-effect propagation before any field-target comparison.

stages.label: Target residuals
stages.purpose: Measure the exact cached teacher minus photo signal by fixed mask regions.

stages.label: Common-state gradients
stages.purpose: Compare photo and field loss gradients on identical saved-state parameter coordinates; no updates.

stages.label: Diagnostic previews
stages.purpose: Render unchanged selected saved model and training-view evidence for inspection.

comparators.label: Photograph target
comparators.purpose: Reference target evaluated at each common state.

comparators.label: High-capacity field target
comparators.purpose: Change target only in each paired gradient comparison.

comparators.label: Photograph target through both paths
comparators.purpose: Common-render target-route and propagated zero-effect control at C0004 of each state; separate photo-only repeatability probe before field comparisons.

primary_metrics.label: Boundary teacher absolute error
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean of 22 per-view region-normalized absolute errors.

primary_metrics.label: Exterior teacher signed bias
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean of 22 per-view region-normalized signed RGB means.

primary_metrics.label: Means full-loss gradient cosine
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean over defined per-view comparisons, first views within state then three seeds then the three declared state types. Keep every state, group and component, undefined counts and full-view-mean gradient separately; headline is descriptive only.

primary_metrics.label: Means full-loss relative gradient difference
primary_metrics.aggregation: Same nested descriptive mean as cosine; denominator reference gradient norm, undefined when <=1e-12; no claim from aggregate alone.

resource_protocol.scope: Descriptive measurement-worker accounting: wall time from coordinator entry through completed diagnostic/previews and entry/exit cache/source receipts, ending before publish(); external administrative raw-seal checks and shared report generation are excluded. CUDA process-wide allocated/reserved peaks reset after synthetic warmup and cover diagnostics/previews through receipt collection. Host ru_maxrss is the process-lifetime high-water mark (including warmup). Per-state and per-view measurements are wall intervals only, not independent memory peaks. No fitting time exists; GPU may be shared.
resource_protocol.aggregation: Three existing seeds are paired saved states, not independent timing repeats. Retain every measured state/view wall interval, global stage intervals, and the recorded process-wide CUDA/host peaks. Do not sum shared/global intervals across series. No performance inference.

cached_input_policy: Use saved four-site quadrature targets verbatim. The inherited raw-data seal is administrative provenance; contract validation/init hashes all original files including heldout bytes but never decodes or computes heldout outcomes. The result-bearing worker opens only the listed training caches and saved states, and rejects all raw dataset reads and other source-run reads. No source reconstruction/refit or new decode.

gradient_protocol.loss: 0.8 * mean(abs(unclamped rendered RGB - cached target)) + 0.2 * (1 - rtgs.core.metrics.ssim(rendered RGB, cached target)); all RGB channels and canvas pixels; exact default tiled 11x11 sigma1.5 SSIM/zero-padding. Black background, use_masks=False, no regularizers.
gradient_protocol.coordinates: means, raw saved quats (renderer normalizes), log_scales, effective-opacity leaf mapped to local logit gradient g_alpha*alpha*(1-alpha), sh0, shN. Pad initial SH to16 bases and evaluate degree0 so shN is zero. For initial reproduce Trainer sigmoid(logit(clamp(opacity,1e-4,1-1e-4))) on CUDA. For final render saved opacity verbatim without clamp or logit roundtrip; map its effective-opacity gradient through the exact local sigmoid factor. Endpoint0/1 has zero mapped gradient and explicit counts. This is a saved-effective-state first-order comparison; raw logits/Adam history are not claimed recovered.
gradient_protocol.component_weighting: L1 and DSSIM gradients are unweighted components; total=0.8*g_L1+0.2*g_DSSIM; exact autograd loss parity selftest.
gradient_protocol.reduction: float64 statistics on float32 CUDA gradients; per-view plus gradient-of-mean-over22views for each state/group/component. Do not compare raw norms between parameter groups with different units. Means of per-view norms and norms of mean gradients are separately labelled. Do not treat seeds/view/state rows as new independent captures. Never compare gradient vectors across different states/topologies; only targets within the same state have row identity.
gradient_protocol.undefined: Relative difference null if photo norm<=1e-12, cosine null if either norm<=1e-12; retain absolute norms and undefined counts.
gradient_protocol.identity_control: At C0004 for eachstate, exercise photo and teacher-identity target routes against one common render, preserving both image adjoints and their difference. Require allL1/DSSIM/total loss differences <=1e-7, image-adjoint differences elementwise <=1e-8+1e-4*max(abs(a),abs(b)), and propagated zero-effect parameter delta elementwise <=1e-8. Retain allgroup/controlstats; failclosed, no postoutcome thresholdchange. This validates zero-effect propagation and targetpath equality; it is not an independent-backward-repeat noise bound.
gradient_protocol.memory: One state/view render graph at a time; image adjoints plus component VJPs. CPUfloat64 statistics/aggregate arrays. Save calibration repeat tensors, perstate mean photo/derivedfield/directdelta vectors, allviewscalarstatistics and loss/control receipts; no optimization. Store perview repeated photo/delta parameter arrays understate/view paths for independentlychecking cancellation/noise. Budget remains5400seconds; no additionalstate/frame orfitting.

synthetic_parity.rule: elementwise abs(a-b) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)); tested before capture outcomes

gradient_protocol.method: Render once at each common state/view. At a detached leaf of the same rendered RGB, compute image-space adjoints h_photo and h_field of the original full-canvas L1 and DSSIM terms through the existing CUDA tiled SSIM. For each component, propagate g_photo=J^T h_photo and delta=J^T(h_field-h_photo) through that one unchanged render graph. Apply the same effective-opacity-to-local-logit chain. Derive g_field=g_photo+delta in CPU float64, retain all vectors/gradients and direct delta statistics. Total gradients are the declared0.8/0.2 component combination. Do not subtract independently accumulated parameter gradients to estimate delta. Synthetic CPU/CUDA comparisons against independently differentiated distinct-target losses must pass before execution.

repeatability_probe.mapping: two fresh render/backward evaluations perseed; seeds only label repeatgroups and do not create independent captures. Use actualphoto/teacheridentity routes alternately.
repeatability_probe.record: For each unweightedL1/DSSIM component and total: loss,renderpixels,imageadjoints,ordinaryparameterVJPs, allconsecutive andallpairwise repeatdelta norms/maxima/cosines andoldthreshold violationcounts. Save rawarrays or exactarraysufficientforindependentreduction. Verify model/targets unchanged.
repeatability_probe.gate: Run the common-render zero-effect check before and after eachrepeat pair with the frozen tolerances. Render and loss differences acrossrepeats <=1e-7 absolute, image-adjoint repeatdifferences elementwise <=1e-8+1e-4relative. Ordinary parameter-VJP repeat variation is the descriptive quantity under investigation and does not pass/fail this newmethod gate; do not call the old elementwise check passed. Stop the follow-up before residual/field stages if any newmethod gate fails.
repeatability_probe.fixed_input_repeats: In addition to six fresh whole-chain repeats, compute six independent image-adjoint evaluations on one fixed detached rendered image, then six parameter VJPs on one retained render graph with one fixed nonzero photo adjoint (perL1/DSSIM/total). Save allrepeat tensors andpairwise summaries. These fixed-boundary experiments distinguish upstream variation from VJP accumulation variation; do not infer isolation merely from tolerated full-chain differences.

gradient_protocol.null_control_boundary: J^T0 is a null/routing control, not a bound on the accuracy of nonzero target differences. The exposed-state numericalprobe and synthetic distinct-target parity do not certify everycalibrateddelta.
gradient_protocol.calibrated_repeat_diagnostics: At everystate/view, repeat both nonzero photo-adjoint VJP and target-adjoint-difference VJP twice on the same retained graph and fixedadjoints. Use CPUfloat64 arithmetic means of those two VJPs for g_photo anddelta; deriveg_field=g_photo+delta. Save bothperview rawgradient tensors (float32 beforeaveraging) or completechecksum-boundarrays, plus pergroup photo_repeat_difference_norm anddelta_repeat_difference_norm. The observednoise proxy is theirsum. Mark effect_resolved_against_observed_repeats iff ||delta|| >10*noise_proxy; reference_resolved iff ||g_photo||>10*photo_repeat_difference_norm; field_resolved iff ||g_field||>10*noise_proxy. Null/near-zero stats stayundefined. Report rawvaluesandflags; weakdeltas/angularcomparisons are numericallyunresolved. Two repeats andthe10×rule are a prospectivelydeclared descriptive precision check, not a statisticalconfidenceinterval or globalaccuracyguarantee; no result-basedrepeatcountchanges.
gradient_protocol.repeat_array_storage: Store float32 mapped photo/delta VJPs forboth repeats andunweightedL1/DSSIM at eachstate/view; declared total arrays/statistics are reconstructed fromtheir0.8/0.2 combination inCPUfloat64. Preserve completecalibrationrepeat tensors forrender/imageadjoint/parameterVJP checks andidentitycontrols. No lossyquantization; npzlosslesscompression. SaveCPUfloat64 perstateview-mean photo/delta/derivedfieldarrays forcomponentsandtotal.

residual_protocol.regions: binary saved mask; boundary=dilation(mask,radius3) XOR erosion(mask,radius3), square7x7 footprint and outside-image background; interior=mask AND NOT boundary; exterior=NOT mask AND NOT boundary. Three disjoint exhaustive regions.
residual_protocol.denominators: Per-channel signed means divide by region pixel_count N. Scalar RGB signed means/MAE/MSE divide by3*N. Full-canvas L1 contribution divides3*H*W. Absolute-error share divides total full-canvas absolute error and is null if that total is zero. Empty regions yield null means/contributions/shares. Regions do not mask the fitting loss or gradients.
residual_protocol.spatial_operator: Local mean=separable box7x7 with reflect padding; local contrast=sqrt(max(box(x^2)-box(x)^2,0)) mean RGB/pixels perregion. Residual lowpass=box(field-photo); highpass=residual-lowpass. These are descriptive spatial-scale summaries, not an orthogonal spectral-energy partition. Full-image neighborhoods are computed before region scoring; no artificial masked SSIM edges.

execution_budget.failure: Newmethod gate failure/nonfinite/OOM/timeout/CUDAfailure stops and preserves thisnewrun; noautomatic retry, target/state selection, oldtaskcompletion or oldthresholdchanges.
execution_budget.warmup: One tiny synthetic CUDA render/backward before measurements.
execution_budget.storage_guard: Beforeinit/worker ensure12GBfree; beforeeachstate/viewwrite verifycanonicaloutputbytes<=10GBandavailabledisk>=2GB. Stop/preservefailureifbudgetviolated, neverdeleteotherdata orreduceprecision/repeatsafteroutcomes. Compressionislossless.

presentation_protocol.previews: New diagnostic plots and calibrated training-view contact sheet plus novel-orbit preview from unchanged selected saved states. No new fitted output; root gaussians.ply and gaussians_init.ply are explicitly labelled existing snapshots.
presentation_protocol.history: Dimensioned diagnostic view records only: step=measurement ordinal; not optimization iterations or a fitting trajectory. Stage markers reflect actual measurements; no fabricated training.
presentation_protocol.server_lifecycle: Use canonical report port8765; an earlier task-owned report server may be replaced for this new diagnostic handoff. Do not stop unrelated services; report locally if an unrelated process owns the port.
presentation_protocol.unavailable_primary: The existing v2 bundle schema requires finite primary scalar metrics. If every applicable value for a primary is undefined (e.g. all reference means gradients <=1e-12), preserve raw null diagnostics and issue a failed presentation/unavailable-primary receipt with no completed metric claim; do not manufacture a value or retry. Partial undefined state/region/group metrics remain null and display as undefined; numeric chart bars omit undefined states with explicit notes/counts retained.

source_lifecycle: New development init-run --development after distinct design and exact final-source approval. Preserve original failed run, its approved source, input/model bytes and thresholds. New driver/helper live under this newtask id, reusing immutable prior math/loaders only. Preserve all executed source bytes, raw dirty source state, protocol/review/seal before execution; verify source/cache entry/exit. Administrative raw seal checks occur in separate processes before/after the guarded worker. No commit/push or private upload.
